Recorded claim:
Freeform Update has its own saved chat and candidate diff. Questions do not edit files; change requests revise an existing candidate or create one; pending candidates must be amended before submit. Rollback restores the starting patch, removes agent-created untracked files, and refuses unrelated dirty state or a different checked-out commit. `freeformOperationRunning` rejects concurrent edit/rollback; interrupted work stays recoverable.
